! -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
! Configuration Authority System
! Version: 2.8.0
! NX-OS:  9.3
! Date:    2026-06-21 17:46:57
! Mode:    Standalone
! Tier:    hardened
! -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

hostname OOB1
!
banner motd # OOB Management — Initial Provisioning #
!
! Local user omitted — set admin password in wizard to create username (lab only).

! Features
feature interface-vlan
feature lldp

! VLAN Configuration
vlan 10
  name USER_10


! L3 SVI Configuration
interface Vlan10
description INTENT_SVI_1
  no ip redirects
  no ip proxy-arp
  no shutdown
  ip address 10.10.0.1/24

! Interfaces & vPC Members

! Management & Routing
interface mgmt0
  ip address 192.168.1.1/24
  vrf member management
  no shutdown
vrf context management
  ip route 0.0.0.0/0 192.168.1.100/24

! NTP
ntp server 10.255.255.254 prefer use-vrf management
! Logging
logging server 10.255.255.254 6 use-vrf management
logging timestamp milliseconds
logging level info
